Mesa 3D (devkitPro's switch-mesa package: libEGL, libglapi and the nouveau
OpenGL driver), linked statically into tssm.nro.

switch-mesa 20.1.0-5 is Mesa 20.1.0-rc3
(https://archive.mesa3d.org/older-versions/20.x/mesa-20.1.0-rc3.tar.xz) with
devkitPro's patches (switch/mesa in https://github.com/devkitPro/pacman-packages).
